## Testing

Describe what you ran and paste the relevant output.

- [ ] The project builds with zero errors

## Security checklist

- [ ] No secrets, keys, or tokens are committed
- [ ] All new external input is validated at the boundary
- [ ] Authentication / authorization is enforced on new endpoints or actions
- [ ] Error messages do not leak sensitive data

## Final gate

- [ ] CI is green

PRs with failing checks will be closed without review.
